title: No delimiter between outputs in non-interactive mode
body:
### What happened?

When I run `gemini -p "..."` and it involves more than one step it  just keeps writing outputs without separating them with newlines and tool calls if they a used not show in any way.

### What did you expect to happen?

I expect it to put some delimeters, i.e. double newline, between output parts.

linked_prs.title: fix(cli): Add delimiter before printing tool response in non-interactive mode
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

This pull request fixes #9048 by adding a newline delimiter between outputs in non-interactive mode. This improves readability for multi-step sessions involving tool calls. A new unit test has been added to verify the correct spacing between consecutive tool call turns.

## Dive Deeper

The core change is a single line in
packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts that writes a newline to stdout
after the tool execution loop finishes for a given turn.
Initially, I settled on a single newline (\n) for a cleaner, more standard command-line experience
that avoids excessive whitespace.

The bulk of the work was in ensuring this was properly tested. I added
 a new unit test in packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts (should
 write a newline between multiple tool call turns) that simulates a
multi-turn conversation with two consecutive tool calls before a final
 text response. It asserts that a newline is printed after each tool
turn.


## Reviewer Test Plan
To manually validate the change, you can run a prompt in non-interactive mode 
that forces a tool call. A good example is using a command that requires 
listing files.
Example Prompt:
`gemini -p "List the files in the 'packages/cli/src' directory and then tell me 
what the 'runNonInteractive' function does."`

Before this change, the output would look something like this, with the final answer immediately following the tool output:
```
[...tool output...]Final answer is...
```

After this change, you should see a clean separation:
```
[...tool output...]

Final answer is...
```

This confirms the delimiter is being added correctly between the tool turn and the final text response turn.
